root_cause_label: Regex-Based XSS Filter Missing Dangerous Tag Removal and On* Prefix Matching
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent committed immediately to a regex approach with a static event-handler list and never added logic to strip dangerous tags (iframe, object, embed, applet) that can execute JavaScript without event attributes, leaving critical XSS vectors unaddressed.
t_err_evidence: In step 1, the agent designs and writes filter.py using a hardcoded enumeration of named event handlers instead of an on* prefix match, and never considers removing dangerous tags like <iframe>, <object>, <embed>, or <applet>, which are required by the reference solution.
t_commit_evidence: The regex-only approach with a fixed event-handler list is written to disk and executed at step 1/2, locking in the incomplete strategy from the very first action with no recovery possible without a fundamental redesign.
trigger_explanation: The agent's plan was directionally correct (remove scripts, event handlers, javascript: URLs) but the code it generated omitted entire categories of XSS vectors (iframe/object/embed/applet tag stripping) and used a brittle enumerated list instead of a prefix-based match for event handlers. No external blocker caused this; the generated code simply lacked the security knowledge needed to cover all required cases.
